'''Horil Damlo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Damlo was a minor political functionary who worked for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], on [[Genarius]]. He held the unimportant position of [[Undersecretary to the Assistant Secretary to the Acting Chief of Information for Senator Wren]] and his job was sit by the door and occasionally to carry out minor errands.
